name: Bandarion Keep
summary: At Bandarion Keep, defenders watch the coast and the woodland for danger. Near the Whispering Forest, the outpost bears Garek Bandarion’s name and is bound to Tyr's Watch.

sections.title: A Bastion on the Western Border
sections.body: Bandarion Keep guards western Tirisfal Glades near the Whispering Forest. Named for Garek Bandarion, the stronghold is closely bound to Tyr's Watch. Quartermaster Jorin Croge works to keep the garrison supplied. Yet the keep lies far from the courtyards of the Undercity.

sections.title: Surrounded by Threats
sections.body: Threats press Bandarion Keep from several directions. Vile Fin murlocs raid the nearby waters, while the Scarlet Crusade tests the defenders in skirmishes. Mindless Scourge thralls wander through the gloom. Some paladins have struggled to accept their unlife as Forsaken and have fallen to madness. They turn their weapons against their own kindred.

faq.answer: Bandarion Keep lies in western Tirisfal Glades near the Whispering Forest.

faq.q: Who was Bandarion Keep named after?
faq.answer: Bandarion Keep bears the name of Garek Bandarion.
Tyr's Watch is bound to Bandarion Keep and the Forsaken paladins who hold it. The keep is counted as part of Tyr's Watch, and the two names are often used interchangeably.

Vile Fin murlocs raid the nearby waters, Scarlet Crusade zealots skirmish with the defenders, and mindless Scourge wander near the keep. Some unstable Forsaken paladins lose their minds and attack their own allies.

angles.text: As a paladin, you may find refuge and warning at Bandarion Keep. Some paladins cannot reconcile the Light with their unlife. They have broken and turned their weapons against their Forsaken peers.
As an undead, you know Bandarion Keep on Tirisfal's western rim must watch for the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. Turmoil within its own ranks threatens it too.
